pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe nà jǐhángzì , xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ cè shàng zǒng xiǎng cādiào de wāi xiàn , táng ruì què xiān zhǐ zuì jiù nà yíchù , shuō nà huí zhuāng de tài kào lǐ , mǔzhǐ huílái huì pèng mù jiǎo .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着那几行字，想起自己册上总想擦掉的歪线，唐芮却先指最旧那一处，说那回装得太靠里，拇指回来会碰木角。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn rújīn ne , tā jiāng yòushǒu kōng zhe bǐ le yíxià , shuō píngcháng bú pèng , nàtiān mùtou liè le , zhǎng yì fān , sōng chūlái de mùpiàn biàn dǎng zài zhèlǐ .

pairs.target: liǎngpiàn tiě yóu táng ruì zìjǐ qǔchū , gē zài diànbù shàng , jiù jìhào hái zài , wéi lǎoshī xiān liáng guò biānjiǎo , zài bǎ tā dàilái de mù zuò nuókāi , méiyǒu jiào tǎ wéi lái jiē .

pairs.english: Her words were somewhat hard; after speaking she turned back the cloth corner a little, letting Tavi see an old copper nail beneath the split, its head ground flat but its surroundings still tight.

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiāng liǎngpiàn tiě fēnbié bāo hǎo , liúxià jiǎnchá de jì bǎn , táng ruì qǔ zǒu de shì kōng mù zuò hé liè dùn , shǒulǐ bǐ láishí qīng , zǒu dào ménbiān què yòu huítóu kàn le yìyǎn .

pairs.target: tā wèn héshí lái qǔ , wéi lǎoshī shuō liángwán xiān sòng huà , bú jiào tā bái děng , mùtou kěyǐ xiān wèn jià , tiě de shì bié ràng lìngyìbiān tì zhèlǐ dāying .
pairs.english: She asked when to collect them; Teacher Vey said she would send word after measuring rather than leave her waiting in vain; she could first ask a price for the wood, but for the iron matter she should not let the other workshop promise on this one's behalf.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sòng tā dào yuànmén , wèn nà kuài jiùyī shìbushì háiyào diàn zhe , táng ruì shuō yào , liè mùtou yě huì zhā rén , yòu búshì bú jiè xìng biàn méi píqì le .
pairs.english: Tavi walked her to the courtyard gate, asking whether the old cloth still needed to pad it; Tang Rui said yes, split wood could prick people too, and lacking an exchange did not mean it had no temper.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维送她到院门，问那块旧衣是不是还要垫着，唐芮说要，裂木头也会扎人，又不是不借性便没脾气了。

pairs.target: tā xiào chūlái , tā jiāng mù biān chóngxīn guǒhǎo , méi bǎ nàxiē xì xiè liúgěi xuégōng sǎo , bāo hǎo cái jiāng shéngjié shōujǐn , huàn dào zuǒshǒu ná .
pairs.english: He laughed; she wrapped the wooden edge again, not leaving those splinters for the academy to sweep; only after wrapping did she tighten the knot and switch to carrying it in her left hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑出来，她将木边重新裹好，没把那些细屑留给学宫扫，包好才将绳结收紧，换到左手拿。

pairs.english: Tavi watched her pass the side gate, turned back to collect the loose thread on the table, and his stomach suddenly growled; only then did he remember he had not eaten breakfast yet.
